user.title: Extron matrix switcher
user.description: Address of the switcher's Ethernet port (Telnet, port 23), or of a serial-to-Ethernet bridge and its port for a unit controlled over its serial port (the IN1508 is serial only). Leave the password empty if the unit has none. Telnet is not encrypted, so only use this on a network you trust.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Extron unit
reconfigure.description: Change how Home Assistant reaches this unit. Leave the password empty if the unit has none.

reauth_confirm.title: Extron password needed
reauth_confirm.description: The unit asked for a password that is missing or was not accepted.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the unit. Check the address and that Telnet (port 23) is allowed.
error.invalid_auth: The unit asked for a password and it was missing or not accepted.
error.not_extron: Something answered, but it did not behave like an Extron matrix switcher.

abort.already_configured: This unit is already set up.
abort.different_unit: That address answered, but it is a different unit.

init.title: Names, refresh and advanced controls
init.description: One name per line, in input or output order. Delete a line's text to go back to the default. Names only change what Home Assistant shows; nothing is written to the unit.

data_description.refresh_seconds: The unit reports changes by itself; this is only a safety net.
data_description.show_advanced: Turns on the group selects, the save and clear preset buttons and the reset buttons for input levels and output volumes (they are off by default). Unticking turns them off again.

error.wrong_count: Give exactly one name per line, for every input or output.

abort.unit_unavailable: The unit is not set up right now, so its names are not known. Try again once it is online.

read_only.message: This unit is set to read-only. Turn that off with Reconfigure to make changes.

route.name: Route
route.description: Tie one input to several outputs at once. Use the names shown for the inputs and outputs (or their numbers). Choose the unit's "All outputs" player.

input.name: Input
input.description: The input's name or number, or None.

outputs.name: Outputs
outputs.description: One or more output names or numbers.

mode.name: Layers
mode.description: Whether to change video and audio together, or only one of them.
